scope: Corollary 6.8 (Transfer of the remaining ordered limits) of the manuscript “Microscopic jamming in the negative spherical perceptron” (preprints/Microscopic-jamming-in-the-negative-spherical-perceptron-September-24-2026/Microscopic-jamming-in-the-negative-spherical-perceptron-September-24-2026.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 222 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 8d94e973e689e60b), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 57. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Fix 0 ≤ ε < ε0(B0). On a full interval above the common threshold, the thermodynamic gap and normalized-force observables at every fixed positive temperature and fixed argument agree with their Gaussian counterparts. Consequently each further ordered limit in the problem exists for the mixture law if and only if it exists for the Gaussian law, and their values agree whenever it exists.
